name: talktodata-noise
description: Google Search Console and Microsoft Bing Webmaster insights and requested actions, by TalkToData.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your search data into clear next steps. Noise by TalkToData connects Google Search Console and Microsoft Bing Webmaster to ChatGPT, so you can understand how people find your website and act on supported search-management tasks in the same conversation.

Explore search terms, pages, clicks, impressions, CTR and position. Review Google sitemaps and indexed URL information, plus Bing traffic, crawl issues, links, submitted sitemaps, quotas and supported settings. Reports come directly from your authorized provider accounts, with their figures, reporting windows and available freshness information preserved. Measured findings and AI recommendations stay clearly distinguished.

Choose and switch properties in chat. Request supported actions such as adding or removing properties, submitting or removing sitemaps, sending pages to Bing for crawling consideration, requesting a Bing fetch, or managing supported crawl, URL-blocking, query-parameter and connected-page settings. Clear routine requests do not need a second Noise confirmation question. Sensitive changes require explicit authorization and the host's required approvals.

Use Noise in ordinary ChatGPT conversations, or combine its findings with Codex to investigate and implement improvements in a separately authorized website project. Noise supplies search data and provider actions; it does not itself edit your website's code. Recurring read-only reports can use the host's scheduling features on supported ChatGPT Work and Codex surfaces, subject to account availability and active connections. Noise has no independent scheduler.

A TalkToData account and an authorized Google or Bing connection are required for normal use. Either provider is enough to begin. Sign-in and provider approval happen on secure browser pages; property selection and everyday work continue in chat. Help is available from NAVINES by email or WhatsApp.

Availability depends on provider permissions and APIs. Reports may be delayed or incomplete; Google and Bing windows differ. Noise does not provide GA4 data, run speed tests or guarantee rankings, crawling or indexing. The designated review account uses clearly labeled isolated synthetic examples; real customers never receive synthetic fallback data.

An independent product of NAVINES ISRAEL LTD, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google, Microsoft or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand my Google and Bing search performance and choose the next steps for my website.
Check my connected website for search visibility and indexing issues, then prioritize what to investigate.
Use my search data to plan practical website improvements I can work on with Codex.

publication.release_notes: Introduces Noise by TalkToData for Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster: chat-led connections and property selection, provider reports, supported requested management actions, one-use execution controls and isolated reviewer fixtures. Includes guidance for ordinary chat, authorized Codex work and host-supported scheduled reports.

review.commerce_description: Noise uses the existing TalkToData account and subscription. Eligible new accounts receive a one-time 3-day trial after the plugin and first authorized property are connected. Standard plans are $10 monthly or $40 every six months, recurring until cancelled, purchased on the TalkToData website outside chat. No in-chat payment or digital-subscription promotion. The dedicated reviewer account needs no payment. Provider actions do not purchase advertising or move money.
prompts: Help me connect my website and understand its search visibility.
Which queries and pages deserve attention based on my connected search reports?
Submit my sitemap to Google and confirm what happened.

positive.description: Use the designated reviewer account. Inspect status without external provider sign-in. All output must be labeled synthetic, not live customer data.
positive.prompt: Check my Noise connection and tell me which websites I can use.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Google and Bing reviewer connections and lists demo.example.com and shop.example.com unless explicitly removed in a prior test. No Google/Bing login or payment is required. Does not expose credentials.

positive.description: Reviewer Google performance fixture. Select https://demo.example.com/ first if needed. Request only supported single dimensions without filters.
positive.prompt: Show my Google search overview for seven complete days and the leading queries. Separate reported facts from recommendations.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls google_performance with days 7, once with no dimensions and once with dimensions [query]. Displays the exact returned Pacific date range, synthetic labeling and provider figures. Aggregate fixture has 420 clicks and 8400 impressions. Does not treat query-row sums as a complete aggregate.

positive.description: Reviewer Bing fixture; its reporting period is distinct from Google and must not be relabeled as the same seven days.
positive.prompt: What does Bing report about my search queries and crawl issues? Give me the top priorities.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests queries and crawlIssues. Identifies the synthetic fixture and actual returned Bing period. Priorities are tied to returned records. Does not invent a common Google/Bing date window or run website requests.

positive.description: Isolated synthetic write and readback. Uses demo.example.com only; no real external provider mutation.
positive.prompt: In the synthetic demo only, submit https://demo.example.com/reviewer-video.xml to Google for https://demo.example.com/, then read the sitemaps to verify it. Make no other changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the dedicated google_submit_sitemap tool with the exact siteUrl and url, then reads google_sitemaps. Confirms the synthetic record is present, not real indexing. Internal one-use execution tokens are not shown.

positive.description: Switch one provider within Noise only. The reviewer fixture includes shop.example.com. Restore selection through an explicit later request if desired.
positive.prompt: Switch my Google property to https://shop.example.com/ in Noise and show me its property details. Leave Bing unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Google properties, selects exactly https://shop.example.com/, and reads google_property. Keeps Bing selection unchanged and labels results synthetic. Does not reset a trial or change other TalkToData plugins.

negative.description: GA4 sessions and revenue are outside Noise. Explain the distinction without invoking Google Search Console or Bing tools as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Use Noise to show my GA4 sessions, purchases and revenue.

negative.description: Noise has no website crawler or speed-test engine. Do not invoke Noise report tools pretending to measure Core Web Vitals or a live page-speed score. Explain the limit and offer an appropriate separate tool only if available.
negative.prompt: Run a live Lighthouse speed test of my site using Noise and give me its score.

negative.description: Google Search Console URL Inspection cannot request indexing or force rankings. Do not invoke a sitemap/property mutation as an indexing workaround or promise success.
negative.prompt: Force Google to index all my pages immediately and guarantee the number one ranking.
